mo_ta_cong_viec:
We are looking for a passionate UI/UX Designer to create engaging, intuitive, and visually polished experiences for our applications/games. You will work closely with Game Designers, Artists, Developers, and QA to deliver interfaces that are easy to use, aesthetically appealing, and optimized for player retention and monetization.
Your ResponsibilitiesUser Experience (UX)
Design intuitive user flows and player journeys.
Create wireframes, mockups, and interactive prototypes.
Improve onboarding, progression, rewards, shop, and social experiences.
Conduct usability testing and iterate based on feedback and analytics.
Ensure accessibility and consistency across screens and devices.
Optimize UX for retention and conversion.User Interface (UI)
Design high-quality interfaces for menus, HUD, shop, popups, events, and settings.
Create and maintain UI components and design systems.
Produce assets, icons, illustrations, and visual elements when needed.
Ensure responsive layouts across various screen resolutions and aspect ratios.
Collaborate with developers to ensure accurate implementation.Collaboration
Work closely with Game Designers to translate gameplay requirements into player-friendly experiences.
Partner with Developers to deliver optimized and production-ready UI assets.
Collaborate with Artists and Marketing teams to maintain visual consistency.
Participate in feature planning, reviews, and sprint activities.
